comparison.objective: Reattach a detached live wrist camera to its native mount and release it secured.
comparison.physical_skill: Cross-arm precision alignment, tapered-channel insertion, latch engagement, and sensor restoration.
comparison.success_condition: Camera aligned and latched with advancing live frames for two seconds after the inserting hand clears; dropping invalidates credit.
comparison.reason: This tests precision insertion and latching of one component, not controlled agitation that separates one loose-body class while retaining another. Earlier binary rubrics lacked partial-credit detail, but later versions resolve it and the distinction is clear.
